items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Who else was in that band?

I remember specifically one trumpet player named Emmitt Berry, who also played with Count Basie’s band and was pretty well known around here as a swing trumpet player. He gave me some tips. With Floyd Ray’s band, there were other players who had also played with Lionel Hampton’s band. These guys were pros. They had been out on the road and [knew] what it was. They would tell me when you had to wear your white shirt on the gig, and after two or three nights, you turn it inside out [laughs].
There’s not much written about Floyd Ray. Can you talk about him?
